title: Revert part of #7077, use testing.Context() in conformance tests
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

I misdiagnosed the cause of some errors I was seeing when running some of the conformance tests in #7077 on my system.  This reverts that commit.
It jhen switches the conformance tests to use the context maintained by the testing.T structure rather than context.TODO(), and to call the VersionWithContext() client API using the context instead of calling regular Version().
It lightly refactors TestCommit() to call the pullImageIfMissing() helper function instead of doing only some of what it does.

#### How to verify it

Tests shouldn't start failing.
